Results and discussion 
Introduction 
Recently much attention has been focused on the 
synthesis of polysubstituted 2 ( 5 H )-furanones due to 
their potential biological activities, which might be used 
as potential insecticides, bactericides, fungicides, an- 
tibiotics, anticancer agents, anti-inflammatories, allergy 
inhibitors, antisoriasis agents, cycloxygenase inhibitors, 
and phospholipase A2 inhibitors, etc .' Due to the sub- 
stituent-loading capability, acidity, and the chirality of 
2,3-allenoic acids, we developed some transition metal- 
catalyzed or mediated methods for the efficient synthesis 
of 2 ( 5 H )-hones starting from 2,3-allenoic acids2' 
and 2,3-allenoates.' Furthermore, we developed a high- 
yielding procedure for the synthesis of P-halobutenolides 
and the subsequent coupling reactions with terminal

Conclusion 
In conclusion, we prepared p-iodo ( or bromo) 
butenolides via the iodo/bmrnolactonization of polysub- 
stituted 2,3-allenoic acids. 'Their Pd(O)-catalyzed Sum- 
ki coupling reaction with organoboronic acids provided a 
simple and efficient route to Caryllalkenyl substituted 
2( 5 H ) -furanones.
